player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Jokkere {player_id} caggal wakkati Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Ko a yi simboolu maako ko '{symbol}'.
Koɗɗe maɗɗe ngoo woni ka hana ka tati ɗer wakkati (kawral, sautu, walla karoje).
So tawii ka yi tati ɗer wakkati, a yi hasara.
Neldu wakkati maa caggal fawnde '[4]' ngam duɗɗe simboolu maa caggal suntu 4.
Caggal Jokkere {player_id}, ko a yi '{symbol}' e jokkere maa ko '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Mangu {player_id} ina woodi alaa ma ({symbol}) e cell {cell}.

outcome.draw: Ɗun ɗon foofta! Walaa mo majjini.
